mutations.before: where c.org_id = $1 and c.deleted_at is null
mutations.because: Grok PT-8e 4: tombstoned campaigns are not selected and not listed; rewriteBrief refuses one, so listing it promises a normalise that cannot happen.
command: a tombstoned campaign is not selected and not listed

mutations.because: Grok PT-8e 8: plan lists a class-(P) campaign that has a draft; a new version makes the draft stale and the resume route deletes it.
command: a class-\(P\) campaign that has a draft is listed with its number of drafts

mutations.before: (select count(*)::int from campaign where org_id = $1) as campaigns,
mutations.after: (select count(*)::int from campaign where org_id = $1 and deleted_at is null) as campaigns,
mutations.because: Grok PT-8e 7 (Q0): the counts are row counts of the org; a filter makes the staging measurement smaller than the tables.
command: the section carries the org's row counts of campaign, brief_version, report and asset, tombstoned rows included
